name: Julien Sanchez - § 25 - Am 17
title: REPORT on the protection of the European Union’s financial interests – combating fraud – annual report 2024
part_text: 25. Emphasises that independent media and investigative journalism play a role in the fight against fraud, corruption, conflicts of interest, and other forms of misuse of public funds; encourages the Commission to support these actors through training programmes, funding, and other measures in line with EU fundamental rights and the rule of law;
